author: Terminally_Brittany
body:
Patagonia Empanadas off of Tustin in Orange.

It's an Argentinian bakery and cafe. This man makes his philo dough in house, fresh, daily. Same with the pasta and empanadas. They are all incredible. Cooked to order.
